source.title: Open Problems for Hanoi and Sierpiński Graphs

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6857616. Local shell fetching could not resolve zbmath.org/api.zbmath.org in the restricted environment. Local resolver indexes and DBLP/ScienceDirect search metadata identified the exact work as Andreas M. Hinz, "Open Problems for Hanoi and Sierpiński Graphs," DOI 10.1016/j.endm.2017.10.058, Electronic Notes in Discrete Mathematics 63 (2017), 23-31. Bounded recovery checked the DOI/ScienceDirect landing page, DBLP resolver/unpaywall links, OpenAlex/local resolver metadata, and exact-title PDF searches; recovered candidates were metadata-only, abstract-only, citation/resolver pages, later citing papers, or different works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered, so no questions were extracted.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/6857616.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
